keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «지구 동물들은 정말 웃기다(처음 생각)» 와 «외계인에게는 사람이 가장 신기한 동물이다(나중 생각)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the first thought (Earth animals are so funny) and the final thought (people are the strangest animals of all). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Zip the alien, a monkey, and people at the zoo

boxes.qen: What does Zip think at first?
boxes.a: Zip thinks Earth animals are so funny.

boxes.qko: 마지막에 지프는 무엇이 가장 신기하다고 생각하나요?
boxes.qen: What does Zip think at the end?
boxes.a: Zip thinks people are the strangest animals of all.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: Zip is an alien. He visits Earth and goes to the
. To Zip, people are the strangest animals of all!

words: Zip is an alien from Planet Moo.
a living thing from another planet
He visits Earth and goes to the zoo.
goes to see a place or a person
He visits Earth and goes to the zoo.
a place where people can see many animals
"Wow! Earth animals are so funny!" says Zip.
A monkey laughs and says, "They are humans!"
To an alien, people are the strangest animals of all!

qs.q: Why does Zip ask, "What are these animals?"
qs.qko: 지프는 왜 «이 동물들은 뭐지?» 하고 묻나요?
opts: He is looking for his spaceship.
He does not know what humans are.
He wants to feed the lions.
evs: He sees lions, monkeys, and elephants.
Zip takes a picture of the humans.
"Wow! Earth animals are so funny!" says Zip.
Zip is an alien from Planet Moo.
why: 지프는 무 행성에서 온 외계인이에요. 그래서 사람이 무엇인지 몰라요.
Zip is an alien from Planet Moo, so he does not know what humans are.

qs.q: "To an alien, people are the strangest animals of all!" What does "strangest" mean here?
evs: He visits Earth and goes to the zoo.
He sees lions, monkeys, and elephants.
Zip takes a picture of the humans.
Then he sees lots of people taking pictures.
why: 사람들이 신기한 동물을 사진 찍듯이, 지프도 사람들 사진을 찍어요. «strangest» 는 가장 이상하고 신기하다는 뜻이에요.
People take pictures of unusual animals, and Zip takes a picture of the humans. "Strangest" means the most unusual.

qs.q: Why does Zip take a picture of the people?
opts: The people ask him for a picture.
He wants to send it to the monkey.
He thinks people are strange, funny animals.
evs: He sees lions, monkeys, and elephants.
He visits Earth and goes to the zoo.
To an alien, people are the strangest animals of all!
why: 지프는 사람들을 «이 동물들» 이라고 불러요. 외계인에게는 사람이 가장 신기한 동물이라서 사진을 찍어요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Zip calls the people "these animals," and to an alien, people are the strangest animals. You need both sentences.

ends: Zip takes his zoo pictures home to Planet Moo.
지프가 동물원 사진을 들고 무 행성으로 돌아간다.
The monkey visits Planet Moo with Zip.
원숭이가 지프와 함께 무 행성에 놀러 간다.

write.src: “I want to <u>visit the zoo</u> because <u>I want to see the monkeys</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because my friends like it)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because my friends like it)

img.cover: At a sunny zoo, Zip, a small green alien with three round eyes, two bendy antennae and a silver suit, stands on a low stone wall and points a silver camera at a crowd of people holding up phones, while an elephant behind the fence and a brown monkey with a big grin on a tree branch watch and laugh.

scenes.1: Near the lion and elephant area of a zoo, Zip, a small green alien with three round eyes, two bendy antennae and a silver suit, tilts his head and stares in wonder at a big group of people holding up phones and cameras.
scenes.2: Beside a tall tree at the zoo, a brown monkey with a big grin hangs from a branch, laughing and pointing at a crowd of people, while Zip, a small green alien with three round eyes, two bendy antennae and a silver suit, listens with his three round eyes wide open in surprise.
